units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Hello, and welcome to another short walk.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: And I'm Ben. It's Friday in Chicago.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Four stops, in two pieces, because the work day sits in the middle.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Exactly. And a theme. Both pieces are about the infrastructure that holds Chicago up.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Anna, it's a train, a pub, a road, and a bridge.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Fine. I'll bet that you can't make a road interesting.
